DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 拾得物をお届けいただいたのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Nagdala kayo ng napulot na gamit, ano?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、交通カードです。落とさないよう財布へ入れたら、自分のカードと二枚重なりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 拾ったカードを財布へ入れ私物と重なったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo, transit card. Inilagay ko sa wallet para hindi mahulog, at nagsama sa patong ng sarili kong card.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag na inilagay ang napulot sa wallet at nasama sa sariling gamit. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どちらを拾ったか、見分けられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Nakikilala ba kung alin ang napulot?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私のカードには名前があります。拾った方にはなく、角に猫のシールがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 名前とシールで二枚を見分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: May pangalan ang akin. Wala ang napulot, at may cat sticker sa sulok.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang dalawang card sa pangalan at sticker. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 使ったり、残高を調べたりはしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Ginamit ba o tiningnan ang balanse?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: していません。ただ、間違えて自分の物として使わないよう分けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未使用で取り違えを防ぎたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Hindi. Pero gusto kong ihiwalay upang hindi aksidenteng gamitin na parang akin.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi ginamit at gustong iwasan ang pagkakapalit. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 二枚の特徴を確認し、拾った一枚をお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Titingnan ang katangian ng pareho at tatanggapin ang isang napulot.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 猫のシールがある方が拾った物です。自分の名前のある方は手元に戻します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 届けるカードを指定して私物を手元へ戻す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Ang may cat sticker ang napulot. Ibabalik ko sa akin ang may pangalan ko.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tukuyin ang isusumiteng card at ibalik sa sarili ang sariling gamit. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 拾った場所と時刻も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Sabihin din ang lugar at oras ng pagkakapulot.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 三十分前、バス停の椅子の下です。届けるのは猫のシールの一枚だけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 発見場所と時刻を述べ一枚だけ届けると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Tatlumpung minuto ang nakaraan, sa ilalim ng upuan ng bus stop. Isang cat-sticker card lang ang isusumite.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang lugar at oras at tiyaking isa lang ang isusumite. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご自身のカードはお返しし、拾得した一枚を記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Ibabalik ang sarili ninyong card at itatala ang isang napulot.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転居届は、もう提出されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Naisumite na ang abiso ng paglipat para sa koreo?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: まだです。明日、旧居の郵便受けの鍵を管理会社へ返します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 転居届未提出で旧居の鍵を返す予定を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Hindi pa. Bukas ibabalik ko sa management ang susi ng mailbox ng dating bahay.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi pa ang abiso at planong ibalik ang lumang susi. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 新しいお住まいへは、すでに移られたのですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、一週間前です。鍵を持っている間は自分で取りに行けると思い、届を後回しにしました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 転居済みだが郵便を取れるので後回しにしたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Opo, isang linggo na. Akala ko habang may susi ay makukuha ko ang sulat, kaya ipinagpaliban ang abiso.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihing nakalipat ngunit naantala ang abiso dahil makukuha pa ang sulat. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 届の受付と転送の開始は確認が必要です。今からの申込みをご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Kailangan tiyakin ang pagtanggap ng abiso at simula ng forwarding. Gagabayan sa aplikasyon ngayon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 鍵を返した翌日から必ず転送されると考えてはいけないんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 鍵返却日が自動的な転送開始日ではないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Hindi pala dapat isiping siguradong forwarded kinabukasan ng pagbabalik ng susi.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Tiyaking hindi awtomatikong simula ang araw ng pagbabalik ng susi. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 開始については手続きの案内を確認してください。旧居への立入りも管理会社へご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Tingnan sa gabay ang simula. Kausapin din ang management tungkol sa pagpasok sa lumang bahay.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 返した後は勝手に入らず、残った郵便物の扱いを管理会社に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 返却後の立入りをせず管理会社に郵便の扱いを聞くと言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Pagkabalik ng susi, hindi ako basta papasok. Itatanong ko ang natitirang sulat sa management.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi papasok pagkatapos magbalik at itatanong ang sulat sa management. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 差出人にも新住所を連絡しておくとよいでしょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Mabuting ipaalam din ang bagong address sa mga nagpapadala.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日届けを出し、開始を確認します。鍵の返却と郵便の受取を別々に調整します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 届の開始と鍵返却を分けて調整すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Isusumite ko ngayon at titiyakin ang simula. Hiwalay kong aayusin ang susi at pagtanggap ng sulat.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Sabihing hiwalay aayusin ang simula at pagbabalik ng susi. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。新旧住所と転居日を確認してご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Titingnan ang luma at bagong address at araw ng lipat, saka gagabayan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 登録変更の控えをご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Tingnan ang inyong kopya ng pagbabago ng rehistro.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 住所は合っていますが、口座番号が全部見えません。別の口座の控えでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 番号が一部見えず別口座か心配だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Tama ang address, pero hindi makita ang buong account number. Para ba sa ibang account ito?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing nag-aalalang ibang account dahil bahagi lang ng numero ang nakikita. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 見えない部分があることだけでは、別口座とは判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Hindi mapagpapasyahang ibang account dahil lang may hindi nakikita.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 最後の三桁は私の口座と同じです。省略した表示かもしれないんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 末尾が一致していることを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Pareho ang huling tatlong digit ng akin. Baka pinaikling display.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipakita na tugma ang hulihan. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 対象となった口座と変更内容を、担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Titiyakin ng namamahala ang account at nilalaman ng pagbabago.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 番号を全部書き足せば分かりやすいと思いましたが、控えには手を加えず見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 控えを書き足さず原状で確認してもらうと言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Akala ko mas malinaw kung isulat ang lahat, pero hindi ko gagalawin ang kopya at ipapakita nang ganoon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi dadagdagan ang kopya at ipapasuri sa kasalukuyang anyo. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認用にお持ちの通帳などはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: May passbook o katulad para sa pagtitiyak?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この通帳です。口座全体の番号は人前で読み上げず、資料で照合していただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通帳を提示し番号を読み上げず照合するよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Itong passbook. Ayokong basahin ang buong numero sa harap ng iba, kaya itugma sa dokumento.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang passbook at hilinging itugma nang hindi binabasa nang malakas. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。資料を使って対象を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Dokumento ang gagamitin para tiyakin ang account.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 同じ口座の住所変更と確認できてから保管します。省略表示だけで変更漏れとは決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 対象確認後に保管し省略だけで漏れと判断しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Itatago ko matapos makumpirmang address change sa parehong account. Hindi ko iisiping may hindi nabago dahil lang pinaikli.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Sabihing itatago pagkatapos tiyakin at hindi huhusgahan ang kulang batay sa pinaikling display lang. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。対象と変更した項目を確認して結果をご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Opo. Titingnan ang account at binagong bahagi, saka ipapaliwanag ang resulta.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どのような商品をお探しですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 国内の原料を使うものです。国内製造とあれば、それで合っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 国内製造で原料も国内産と判断できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Gamit ang lokal na sangkap. Kapag manufactured domestically, iyon na ba?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung domestic manufacture ay katumbas ng lokal na sangkap. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この商品の表示では、作った場所と原料の産地が別に書かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Sa label na ito, hiwalay ang lugar ng paggawa at pinanggalingan ng sangkap.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 原料の欄には外国の名前があります。国内で作ったことと、原料が国内のものということは別ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 製造場所と原料欄の外国名を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: May pangalan ng ibang bansa sa sangkap. Magkaiba pala ang paggawa rito at lokal na sangkap.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang paggawa at pangalan ng bansang nasa sangkap. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。ご希望の条件に関わる欄を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Opo. Tingnan ang bahaging tungkol sa gusto ninyong kondisyon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この一語だけで買わず、原料の表示も見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 製造の一語だけで買わず原料表示を確認したいと言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Hindi ako bibili dahil sa salitang iyon lang. Gusto ko ring tingnan ang sangkap.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi bibili sa manufacturing phrase lang at titiyakin ang sangkap. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 別の商品も、包装ごとに確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Maaari ring tingnan bawat pakete ng ibang produkto.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: こちらは原料の産地が見えにくいです。担当に確認できる資料があるか聞けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別商品の読みにくい産地について資料確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Mahirap makita ang pinagmulan nito. Maaari bang itanong kung may dokumento sa namamahala?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Hilinging tingnan ang dokumento para sa mahirap basahing pinagmulan ng ibang produkto. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認します。はっきりしない部分を推測してはご案内しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Titingnan ko. Hindi kami magbibigay ng hula sa malabong bahagi.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。原料の情報が確認できてから、希望に合う商品を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認できた原料情報で選ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Salamat. Kapag tiyak ang sangkap, pipili ako ng tugma sa gusto.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Sabihing pipili batay sa natiyak na sangkap. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。表示の資料があるか担当へ照会します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Itatanong ko kung may dokumento ng label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 地図を見ながらお困りですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。ここが現在地とありますが、写真の入口が見えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 写真の現在地と実際の景色が違うと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo. Nakasulat current location dito, pero hindi ko makita ang pasukang nasa litrato.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag na iba ang lokasyon sa litrato at totoong tanawin. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その地図は、どこで撮ったものでしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 南門です。その後、池を半周してここへ来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 地図を撮った場所と移動経路を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Sa timog na gate. Pagkatapos umikot ako sa kalahati ng lawa papunta rito.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang lugar ng litrato at dinaanan. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 写真の現在地の印は、その案内図を置いた南門の位置です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Ang marker ng litrato ay posisyon ng timog na gate kung saan naroon ang mapa.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 歩くと印も今の場所になると思っていました。ここはどこでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 印は更新されないと気づき今の場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Akala ko nagiging kasalukuyang lugar ang marker habang naglalakad. Nasaan kami ngayon?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Mapansing hindi nag-a-update ang marker at itanong ang kasalukuyang lugar. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 池の北側の広場です。こちらの案内図なら、この広場が現在地です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Liwasan sa hilaga ng lawa. Sa mapang ito, liwasang ito ang current location.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 新しい図では池が南側ですね。南門の写真と向きを比べて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現在の案内図と池の位置を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Sa bagong mapa, nasa timog ang lawa. Ihahambing ko ang direksiyon sa litrato ng timog na gate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Itugma ang kasalukuyang mapa at posisyon ng lawa. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 位置が違うことを確かめて、行きたい場所までの園路をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Tiyaking iba ang lokasyon, saka tingnan ang daan patungo sa gusto ninyong lugar.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 現在地をこの広場に直して考えます。前の印から道をたどり直すのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今の広場を出発点にして経路を考えると言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Dito sa liwasan ko ituturing ang lokasyon. Hindi ko na susundan muli ang daan mula sa lumang marker.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Sabihing kasalukuyang liwasan ang pagsisimulan ng ruta. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。今いる北側の広場を出発点にしてお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Opo. Magsimula sa hilagang liwasan kung nasaan kayo ngayon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どのような経路をお探しですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 腰がつらいので、乗り換えが一番少ない経路にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 腰の負担を減らすため乗り換えを少なくしたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Masakit ang ibabang likod ko, kaya gusto ko ang pinakakaunting lipat.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing gustong bawasan ang lipat para sa likod. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 乗り換えを減らしたいのですね。立っている時間も気になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Bawas lipat, ano? Inaalala rin ang tagal ng pagtayo?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。長く立つのが難しくて、座れるかが気になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 立ち続けることが難しいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Opo. Mahirap tumayo nang matagal, kaya inaalala kung makakaupo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag na mahirap patuloy na tumayo. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 乗り換えが少ないだけでは、座れるとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Hindi nangangahulugang makakaupo dahil lang kaunti ang lipat.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、次の列車とその後の列車では、待つ場所や乗り方を比べられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 列車ごとの待ち方を比較できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Kung ganoon, maaari bang ihambing ang paghihintayan at pagsakay sa susunod na tren at kasunod pa?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Itanong kung maihahambing ang paghihintay ayon sa tren. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 時刻とホームは案内できますが、空席の保証はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Maibibigay ang oras at plataporma, pero hindi garantiya ng upuan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 座れると決めつけず、少し余裕を取って移動したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 空席を前提にせず時間の余裕を持ちたいと言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Gusto kong maglaan ng oras sa paggalaw nang hindi ipinapalagay na makakaupo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihing may palugit sa oras nang hindi umaasa sa bakanteng upuan. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 途中で休める場所も確認しておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Tingnan din natin ang pahingahan sa daan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 乗り換えの数だけで選ばず、待つ時間と休める場所も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 乗り換え数以外に待ち時間と休憩場所も聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Hindi lang bilang ng lipat, pakisabi rin ang tagal ng hintay at pahingahan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Itanong ang oras ng hintay at pahingahan bukod sa lipat. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらの経路から順にご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Ipapaliwanag mula sa rutang ito.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 新しい住所の記入でお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Nahihirapan sa pagsulat ng bagong address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。契約書は「サンハイツ」、案内は「SUN HEIGHTS」です。別の建物でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二つの書類で建物名が違うと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo. San Heights sa kontrata, SUN HEIGHTS sa gabay. Ibang gusali ba?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing magkaiba ang pangalan ng gusali sa dalawang papel. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この二枚だけで別の建物とは判断できません。所在地と部屋番号は一致していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Hindi mapagpapasyahang iba sa dalawang papel lang. Tugma ang street address at room number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 番地も部屋番号も同じです。建物名だけが違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 番地と部屋番号は一致すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Pareho ang numero ng address at kuwarto. Pangalan lang ng gusali ang iba.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihing tugma ang address at kuwarto. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その違いを、書類を出す際にもお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Sabihin din ang kaibahang iyon kapag isinumite.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 日本語に自分で訳して書けばいいと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分で訳した名前を書こうとしていたと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Akala ko puwedeng sarili kong isalin sa Hapon at isulat.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihing balak isulat ang sariling salin ng pangalan. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 自己判断で新しい表記を作らず、こちらで確認してから記入しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Huwag gumawa ng bagong baybay nang sarili. Tiyakin muna rito, saka isulat.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 契約書と案内の両方を見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 両方の書類を確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Maaari bang tingnan ang kontrata at gabay pareho?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Hilinging tingnan ang dalawang dokumento. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。どちらの表記を使うか、住所の情報と合わせて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Opo. Titiyakin kung aling baybay kasama ng impormasyon ng address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 確認が終わってから、案内された建物名の表記で記入します。部屋番号は三〇二です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 部屋番号を示し確認後の表記で記入すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Pagkatapos tiyakin, isusulat ko ang itinurong pangalan ng gusali. Kuwarto 302.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ibigay ang kuwarto at sabihing gagamit ng natiyak na baybay. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 番地と部屋番号の一致を確認しました。建物名に使う表記を確かめてからご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Tugma na ang address at kuwarto. Titiyakin muna ang pangalan ng gusali bago gabayan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Pagbabago ng araw ng appointment, ano?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。母の介護でその日に来られません。母の病名も説明する必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 介護で来られない理由と説明範囲の疑問を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo. Hindi ako makapunta dahil nag-aalaga sa nanay. Kailangan ding sabihin ang diagnosis niya?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang pag-aalaga at tanong kung gaano ang paliwanag. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約変更のご相談では、まず来られない日と希望日を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Sa pagbabago, una ang araw na hindi makakapunta at gustong araw.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家族の詳しい病状までは、ここで話さなくてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家族の詳しい病状が必要か確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi na kailangang detalyado ang sakit ng pamilya rito?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Tiyakin kung kailangan ang detalyadong sakit ng pamilya. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 変更の受付に必要な内容を確認します。ご自身の診療に関わることは担当へご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Titingnan ang kailangan sa pagtanggap ng pagbabago. Ang tungkol sa sarili ninyong pagagamot ay sa namamahala.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私の受診について、薬が次の候補日まで足りるかも気になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自身の薬が候補日まで足りるか気になると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Tungkol sa sarili kong konsultasyon, inaalala ko kung sapat ang gamot hanggang sa susunod na posibleng araw.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihing nag-aalala kung sapat ang sariling gamot hanggang bagong posibleng araw. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それは受付だけで判断できませんので、担当に確認する必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Hindi lang reception ang makakapagpasya, kailangang itanong sa namamahala.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 日付だけ変える前に、薬について相談することも伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 変更前に薬の相談も担当へ伝えるよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Bago baguhin lang ang araw, pakisabi ring gusto kong kumonsulta sa gamot.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Hilinging ipasa ang usaping gamot bago magbago. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。現在の予約日と、お薬についてのご相談を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Titiyakin ang araw ngayon at tanong sa gamot.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 予約は来週の月曜です。薬の件を確認してから変更日を決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 元の予約日を示して確認後に変更日を決めたいと言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Sa susunod na Lunes ang appointment. Gusto kong magpasya ng bago matapos matiyak ang gamot.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ibigay ang orihinal na araw at gustong magpasya matapos magtiyak. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 来週月曜の予約と、お薬が足りるかのご相談として担当へ伝えます。変更日は確認後にご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Sasabihin ang appointment sa susunod na Lunes at kung sapat ang gamot. Pagkatapos tiyakin gagabayan sa bagong araw.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車の登録番号は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Alam ang registration number ng bisikleta?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。この写真の四桁です。鍵の横に貼っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 写真の数字を登録番号として示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo, apat na digit sa litratong ito. Idinikit ko sa tabi ng kandado.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang numero ng litrato bilang registration number. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その数字は、どのような番号でしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 番号式の錠を使うために、私が書いたメモです。登録番号とは違いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 数字が私用の錠の番号だったと訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Note na isinulat ko para sa combination lock. Hindi pala registration number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Itama na pribadong lock code ang mga numero. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 錠の番号を登録番号として記録しないよう、資料を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Tingnan ang dokumento upang hindi maitala ang lock code bilang registration.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 購入時の控えがあります。この登録の欄を見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 購入控えの登録欄の確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: May kopya ng pagbili. Maaari bang tingnan ang bahaging registration?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Hilinging tingnan ang registration sa kopya ng pagbili. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。こちらの番号と、車体の情報を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Opo. Titingnan ang numerong ito at detalye ng bisikleta.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 鍵を開ける数字は、相談に必要な登録情報とは分けて扱いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 解錠の数字と届出用情報を分けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Gusto kong ihiwalay ang pambukas sa kailangang registration information para sa konsultasyon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihing gustong ihiwalay ang unlock code at impormasyong pang-ulat. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。公開する写真などにも、その数字が写っていないかご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Tingnan ding hindi lumilitaw ang numero sa mga pampublikong litrato.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 特徴を示す時はそのメモを見せず、登録控えを使って説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 特徴写真に私用番号を出さず登録控えで説明すると言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Sa pagpapakita ng katangian, hindi ko ipapakita ang note, kundi kopya ng registration.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi ilalabas ang private code sa feature photos at gagamit ng registration copy. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。登録情報と、なくなった場所や時刻を順に伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Itatanong nang sunod ang registration, lugar at oras ng pagkawala.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 昨日の郵便物についてのご相談ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。必要な添付書類を一枚入れ忘れました。今、その封筒に足せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 発送済みの封筒に不足書類を足せるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo. Nakalimutan ko ang isang kailangang attachment. Maaari bang idagdag sa sobre ngayon?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung puwedeng idagdag ang kulang sa naipadalang sobre. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: すでに差し出されたものへ、この場で中身を足せるとはご案内できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Hindi namin masasabing puwedeng dagdagan dito ang naipadala na.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ相手に着いていないので、ここで開けられると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未到着なら開けられると思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi pa nakakarating, kaya akala ko puwedeng buksan dito.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag na inakalang mabubuksan habang hindi pa dating. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まず、控えと発送状況を確認しましょう。提出先へも不足の扱いを確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Una, tingnan ang kopya at shipping status. Itanong din sa tatanggap ang kulang.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 不足分だけ別に送れば受理されるか、提出先へ聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 不足分だけの追送可否を提出先へ確認すると言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Itatanong ko kung tatanggapin ang kulang lang na hiwalay ipadala.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihing ititiyak ang pagpapadala ng kulang lamang sa tatanggap. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その確認と、郵便物の取扱いについての相談は分けて進めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Ihiwalay ang pagtiyak na iyon sa konsultasyon sa pag-asikaso ng koreo.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: こちらの控えを見てください。出したのは昨日の夕方です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 控えと差出時刻を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Tingnan ang kopyang ito. Kahapon sa bandang hapon ko ipinadala.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang kopya at oras ng padala. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が取扱いを確認します。追加の書類はまだ差し出しませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Titingnan ng namamahala ang pag-asikaso. Hindi muna ipapadala ang dagdag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。相手の回答を聞いてから、追送するのかほかの方法か決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 相手の回答前に追加発送せず方法を決めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Opo. Pagkasagot ng tatanggap, magpapasya kung hiwalay ipadala o ibang paraan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Sabihing walang dagdag na padala bago sumagot at pipili ng paraan. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。まず、この一件の状況を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Una, tingnan ang kalagayan ng padalang ito.
